messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up — ClaraTech onboarding has plateaued. Health score dropped from 78 -> 52 yesterday. They hit the integration step but stopped after env creds were requested. Looks like renewal in 6w. Need a short save plan and an owner for enablement + downgrade-path prework.
Tom L: On it. I chatted with their engineer earlier — they said they were blocked waiting on IT to open a port and schedule a maintenance window. No product bugs reported.
Priya (Success Eng): I can run a focused 45m workshop to unblock their engineer and pair on network steps. Suggest we prepare a 1-page checklist + an invite for next 48h.
Miguel R: We should also prep a low-friction downgrade/alternate plan in case they want to reduce capacity. Draft messaging for pricing/legal and a temporary credit offer to buy us time.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks. Can we split tasks: Priya runs enablement session (owner), Tom handles infra comms and confirms maintenance window, Miguel drafts the downgrade-swap and credit offer copy, I’ll own the customer-facing email and follow-ups. Target: have the plan + materials ready by EOD tomorrow.
OnboardBot: Automated note: ClaraTech onboarding_score=52; last_event=integration-request; assigned=Aisha (CSM). See /onboard-dashboard for details.
Priya (Success Eng): Draft checklist snippet below — I’ll refine and share as a calendar invite.
```
Pre-work checklist for ClaraTech 45m unblock
- Confirm public IP + port whitelist with IT
- Provide temporary test token (sandbox) and sample payload
- Verify firewall rules + curl test from their infra
- Share logs if error persists
```
Tom L: Copy. I’ll ping their IT contact (cc @Aisha) and propose Tue 10am or Wed 2pm maintenance windows. If IT is the blocker, we aim to avoid product-level changes.
Miguel R: Draft downgrade-swap outline for legal/sales: 1) move to single-model small instance, 2) pause autoscale, 3) 30% credit for one billing cycle. Customer messaging (short): "We can temporarily reduce capacity and apply a one-time credit while you finish IT changes — this keeps costs predictable and avoids interruption." Will post a concrete e-mail draft later today.
Aisha (CSM): Good. Also capture feedback after the session — quick NPS+2 targeted questions: Was the workshop useful? Did the checklist resolve the blocker? Save answers in the ticket so product can surface repeated friction.
Priya (Success Eng): Agree. I’ll add a 2-question post-session form link in the invite.
Tom L: If maintenance slips >72h, we should trigger a higher-touch play: assign a TAM and offer a short dedicated-window from our infra team to run the test.
Miguel R: +1. If they accept credit/discount, we’ll mark as "at-risk — active save" in renewal tracker and schedule a renewal touch 3w before term.
Aisha (CSM): Action list summarized: Priya = session + post-form; Tom = IT scheduling + escalation if >72h; Miguel = downgrade/credit draft + email copy; Aisha = customer email + renewal tracker update. Will follow up with a quick thread update after session.
Priya (Success Eng): I’ll run the session tomorrow 10:30am (tentative). Sending invite now.
Tom L: Confirmed maintenance window Tue 10 also works for IT, I’ll sync them in thread.
Miguel R: Posted the initial email copy in #sales-drafts so Legal can review quickly.
Aisha (CSM): Great teamwork — ❤️. Let’s aim to close the blocker within 48h and avoid a downgrade. :thumbsup:
